title: Thai Crispy Fried Wontons
description: Crispy fried wontons filled with a savory Peruvian-inspired garlic mixture, perfect as a snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: Peruvian garlic mixture (garlic, air, crumbly, fried)

instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Cut the wonton wrappers into triangles.
Place a small spoonful of Peruvian garlic mixture in the center of each triangle.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wonton wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Fry the wontons in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per batch.
Drain the wontons on paper towels.
Serve hot with soy sauce and sesame oil for dipping, if desired.
Garnish with crumbly fried garlic, if desired.
